name: Marek Tóth
biography: Marek Tóth is a security researcher from the Czech Republic specializing in web application security. In his free time, he conducts independent research or reports critical vulnerabilities that could be exploited by attackers, with a recent focus on Czech companies. He shares interesting findings on his personal website, youtube channel or presents them at conferences, primarily at OWASP Chapter meetups.
